# WK28 · Agent chăm sóc của bệnh nhân · Dòng thời gian

Group **WK · Agent chăm sóc (Next.js)** · page · Next.js: **exists (design W2)** (`/care/patients/[id]/timeline`) · account `cs_staff`

## Purpose
Care agent of one patient, tab 1: who holds the conversation now, why the agent asked for a person, drafts waiting for approval, reminders that are paused, what the agent did, and what it remembers about the patient.

## Agent and care context
- The page shows the control state: "Agent phụ trách" (AUTO), "Đang tìm người nhận" (HANDOFF_ROUTING), "Nhân viên phụ trách" (STAFF), and the autonomy level now and the agent's base level (L0 only drafts, L1 approved template messages, L2 answers with a source). When a person holds the conversation, scheduled reminders are paused, not sent; the card "Nhắc đang tạm dừng" lets staff copy the prepared text and send it by hand.
- "Nháp đang chờ người duyệt": the agent never sends these while a person has not approved them (patient_channel). "Agent nhớ gì về khách" holds habits and instructions, no medical record.

## Who may see it
- Account in this frame: `cs_staff` (a mock account of `mock/auth.ts`; the back end decides the real matrix, the menu is a convenience).
- Gate: `care.read` (checked by the layout of `/care`; not a menu entry).
- Roles that can open the page: owner, manager, doctor, cs_staff.
- Menu entry: not a menu entry (reached by link, redirect or the shell itself).

## Key actions
- Link "Hồ sơ bệnh nhân" to Patient 360
- Tab bar "Dòng thời gian" | "Trả lại cho agent" | "Nói với agent"
- Draft rows link to the review queue (`/review?i=`)
- "Sao chép để gửi tay" on a paused reminder

## Business rules
- Control state per patient: AUTO (the agent answers or acts by its autonomy level L0 to L2; staff supervise the timeline and approve drafts) → HANDOFF_ROUTING (the agent is silent towards the patient except one template holding message, summarises for the candidate, runs the routing loop) → STAFF (the agent does not react, sends no scheduled reminders; it observes and drafts suggestions that are not sent). Only a staff member returns a conversation to AUTO (PLAN-AI01-M section 5).
- The agent decides to hand over by itself (skill `handoff`): depth D1 administrative, D2 standard care, D3 mild expected symptom, D4 medical judgement, D5 red flag. Defaults: D1 answers from L1, D2 answers from L2 with a source, D3 draft plus approval, D4 always calls a person, D5 calls a doctor at once without calling the model. The matrix that holds these numbers is configuration and carries "Chờ bác sĩ duyệt" until a doctor approves it (section 6).
- The candidate chain is 3 to 5 people and its last element is always the 24/24 on-call Zalo number, kept in the database, never in code. Default SLA: urgent 5 minutes, normal 30 minutes, outside working hours until the start of the next shift (section 7).
